lina-partners: Quick sync — partner onramp for CloudVendorX marketplace. We need a final Terraform module layout + README for the starter reference arch (k8s inference + autoscaler + logging). Can someone own module layout + example?

matt-eng: +1 on the layout. Please don't include provider {} in modules. Standardize var names: region, cluster_name, node_pools. Also add outputs: cluster_endpoint, kubeconfig_raw.

nina-arch: FYI design constraints: must support dedicated and hosted routing paths, and optional firewall rules for private deployments. Proposal: package as three composable modules: network, cluster, inference-stack. Keep examples in /examples/gcp and /examples/aws.

carlos-terraform: I can PR scaffolding by EOD. Example usage:

```
module \"inference_stack\" {
  source = \"github.com/redwood/inference-modules//inference-stack\"
  project = var.project
  region  = var.region
  cluster_name = module.cluster.name
}
```

I'll add a top-level example that wires network->cluster->inference-stack and a README with KMS/HSM notes.

deploy-bot: PR #482 ready for review — checks passing :white_check_mark:

lina-partners: Awesome, thanks. Let's pair-review tomorrow 11am PT. Action items: carlos PR, matt to add variable/outputs lint rules, nina to draft reference arch diagram for docs. :thumbsup:
